column1: # tests/compound/entry_ranks.tsv -- E0's HAND RANK FIXTURE
# (docs/design/compound_entries.md §3.2, §3.6; a precondition of E1).
# Written by hand from the EMITTED C, never from src/gen/entries.c: each row
# names a witness artifact, one edge `from -> to` of its call graph, the
# rank that edge's call site has by its place in the controller, and the
# call-site text in `from`'s body with its exact count, so the checker can
# hold the witness to the site it is meant to reach ([MECH-REACH]).
#   R3 inner        inside a per-candidate or per-attempt loop
#   R2 per-call     once on every call
#   R1 conditional  on a data-dependent subset of calls
#   R0 rare         an error, tie or fallback path
# Columns: rank, witness id, arms (comma list of utf8/utfcheck/vm, or -),
# pattern (verbatim; no tab), from, to, site (a substring of `from`'s body),
# count (its exact number of occurrences there). A rank with no witness is a
# row `RANK<TAB>UNWITNESSED<TAB>reason`, reported and never passed; a rank
# with neither is a failure.
# [FINDALL-NEXT] I1 (lane i1tri2): a DFA body's sites are `find`'s (`rx__find`,
# which `search` and `next` call); a VM `search_run`'s are in its search loop
# `rx__find`; residual calls name the static twin `rx__<name>`.
